descriptionChirho: To tear or rip apart, especially of a wild beast seizing and rending prey; used literally of animal predation and figuratively of violent destruction by enemies or God.
Passive of tearing: to be torn apart or mauled, said of animals or people who are victims of predation or violent attack (Nifal and QalPass forms).
Hifil causative sense: to give food to someone, to feed or provide nourishment, a distinct meaning from the tearing sense.
